The '''Kelpwoven Tunnels''' are a sub-location of the [[Moonglade Marsh]].

== Features ==
The '''Kelpwoven Tunnels''' consist of several tunnels filled with coral, where {{MobSprite|Spike}}s can be hunted. The {{Zone|Bubbleboost Column}} can be found here and leads to the {{Zone|Wyrmgrove Tomb}} and {{Zone|Tangleburg}}.
